description: Ex-24 Squadron SAAF strike aircraft, mounted on a low plinth on open ground inside the base perimeter at the north-west corner of AFB Waterkloof, immediately behind the boundary fence on a public suburban street in Valhalla. Confirmed in position by a dated geotagged photograph of 24 May 2014 and again on current Esri World Imagery at z20. Satellite fix on the airframe: -25.816222, 28.210398. Remains SAAF property and is on the SAAF Museum inventory.
aliases: Buccaneer S.50;Buccaneer S50;Buccaneer S Mk 50;Blackburn Buccaneer

description: Ex-12 Squadron SAAF dual-control trainer, on a plinth beside a public road inside the base's northern domestic area, about 560 m south of the Buccaneer. Confirmed by a dated geotagged photograph of 24 May 2014 and independently visible on current Esri World Imagery. Separate satellite fix on this airframe: -25.820901, 28.212164.
aliases: Canberra T.4;Canberra T4;Canberra T Mk 4;English Electric Canberra

description: Listed as an AFB Waterkloof static display on the Unofficial SAAF Website airframe list and named in a 2013 forum inventory. NOT found on satellite imagery in the northern base area or along the hangar line, and absent from the Wikipedia surviving-Sabres list, which records only 361, 367 and 372 in South Africa. Serial 369 is carried on the strength of the SAAF list alone; present location on the base and current condition unconfirmed.
aliases: Sabre Mk 6;Sabre Mk6;CL-13B Sabre Mk 6;CL13B Sabre Mk 6;Canadair Sabre;F-86 Sabre;F86 Sabre

description: Listed as a gate guard at AFB Waterkloof on the Unofficial SAAF Website list. Absent from the 2013 enthusiast gate-guard inventory of the same site, which placed F1CZ 202 at Air Force Headquarters and gave Waterkloof only the Sabre, Buccaneer and Canberra, so the Waterkloof Mirage is a later addition. Not found on satellite imagery. Single-sourced; serial unverified against any photograph.
